correctness.rationale: At modal depth one, every modal scope is propositional and is therefore invariant under induced carrier restriction. A restricted box minimum equals the original witnessed infimum exactly when the retained set contains an original minimizer; the diamond maximum is dual. Thus simultaneous preservation is exactly hyperedge hitting. One witness per edge plus the root gives the upper bound, and the explicit crisp singleton-witness family proves sharpness.

residual_risks: A comparable one-step pruning theorem may exist in coalgebraic modal logic, neighborhood semantics, or fuzzy-model minimization under terminology not recovered by the checked searches.

The hypergraph-transversal proof is elementary once witnessedness and modal depth one are isolated, so the claim is a structural sharpening rather than a deep extension of the primary completeness theorem.

value.rationale: GW's defining semantic feature is attainment of modal extrema, and its finite-model proof explicitly allocates worlds as modal witnesses. The theorem gives a complete natural classification of which worlds are necessary in the canonical one-step fragment, identifies the exact minimum by a standard combinatorial invariant, and proves a sharp universal \(m+1\) bound. This provides a reusable base case for deeper recursive pruning and a concrete benchmark for finite countermodel extraction.
